subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt the open fork PR as the implementation path for this issue, or close that path and request a fresh upstream PR?
rationale: The source-level issue remains, but the linked implementation candidate is outside the upstream repository, cannot be modified by maintainers, and targets the older UI path, so automation should not start a duplicate fix until a maintainer chooses the landing path.

options.title: Adopt or port the fork patch
options.body: Use the linked fork PR as the source patch, port it to `ui/src/pages/channels/view.ts`, refresh tests, and then land it through an upstream branch.

options.title: Request a fresh upstream PR
options.body: Leave this issue open and ask for a same-repository replacement PR with the same resolver behavior and focused regression coverage.

options.title: Close the fork path first
options.body: If maintainers do not want to adopt the fork branch, close or disregard that candidate before allowing a new automated fix lane.

recommendation.title: Adopt or port the fork patch
recommendation.body: Use the linked fork PR as the source patch, port it to `ui/src/pages/channels/view.ts`, refresh tests, and then land it through an upstream branch.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest history across the channel UI metadata, Control UI, and runtime channel registry surfaces involved in the decision.
